body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; revise this entry when one is fixed. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 87 (2026-10-29 00:55Z) adds REVIEW BRIEF DROPPED (w-03f5) and compacts wording; rev 86 holds the longer texts.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL output. Review results are parent-only (w-fb35d7e76d72): the parent copies the full findings verbatim to MAIN target/tmp/*-review-findings.md and sends the path.
!! REVIEW BRIEF DROPPED (w-03f5e1cd2f30): spawning with `/review-code <text>` silently DROPS <text>. Use `/review-code -- <instructions>`, then read back the stored delegation.prompt before trusting the review.
!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task, Monitor or subagent. No `engram doctor` on a live store. No foreground Bash in the coordinator while an Engram gate or a credited run is in flight (w-350df830dfd0).
!! CLAUDE REVIEWERS: default model Opus. Use Sonnet, then Kimi, only if a fresh Opus attempt is refused; record the refusal text. Kimi never stands in for both reviewers.
!! A CLAUDE EXPLORER IS NOT READ-ONLY (P1 w-dc7657cc3529). Spawn read-only Claude delegations in REVIEWER mode.

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full); results are in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (w-8f7e2d914724).
- CLAUDE lanes: ONE call `pushd "DIR" && <test>` is credited; piping, chaining or an env prefix is not (w-1d9259ed138e).
- A --target-dir outside the named root is refused credit (w-32d02e1dd7f6).
- Credit binds to the turn's focused claim and the root's named binding (w-fec83085cff0). Never rerun only for credit.
- SETTLEMENT LAG (w-667e66aecbff): after a terminal result, END the turn; edit the root only in the NEXT turn.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends in its starting turn (w-67d248c998ef).
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep a worktree folder locked (w-eaee4f7c441c): leave it.
- ANY command by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root refuses that gate's credit (w-4a8d9a7a7d08).
- While gated control is OFF, a gate run is base-mode: no typed host credit arrives (w-af3c30bfe828); don't wait for one.

WAKES AND MAIL
- Nothing wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac): re-send after durableButNotWoken, but check the status first.
- LATE WAKE (P2 w-4e44aca45353): "deliveredToIdleSession" is set at dispatch and does not prove the turn ran. Check the recipient's processedThrough. A grant unread for about 15 min is withdrawn.
- Idempotency keys are unique per SENDER (w-b7b80d980e7a): use recipient-qualified keys.
- Use the plain "session-N" id for local recipients; "host:<central>::session-N" creates a new mailbox (w-623c0e4ca176).

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at MAIN; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root takes effect next turn. Clear after done; an own-clear 409 "holds no live claim" (w-b964389ee54a): leave it.
- EVALUATION 409s (P1 w-33f4cde5413c):
  (a) after a fresh naming or ANY tracker write, END the turn and wait ≥60 s, then evaluate in a separate turn;
  (b) "stopped naming the source root": re-name, end the turn, then ONE fresh evaluation;
  (c) after landing, name the LANDED root;
  (d) the evaluator cites ONLY the holder's own notes;
  (e) "no sighting of ... named root ... at evidence basis" needs a gated checkpoint; parked on w-af3c30bfe828 while control is OFF.
- SECOND ITEM IN ONE SESSION (w-6cf3141a12c3): switch focus, checkpoint, END idle, then ONE fresh evaluator.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason).

FREEZE: freeze with the WORKTREE as cwd, the input STAGED by explicit `git add` (never -A) (w-13b44cf369af). The schema-1 fingerprint hashes HEAD plus the staged diff, so a clean commit checkout of the same tree has a DIFFERENT fingerprint (joint remote-gate record r3).

GATES: a FOREGROUND `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full` from the named root, or a remote gate per memory rules-greg-equivalent-gate-hosts-2026-10-28. START to Fable2 first. A second concurrent Cargo job only at 40 GiB or more (rules-greg-b16-acceleration-2026-10-28). A failed gate discards that round's reviews.

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): no tracker write in the turn of termal_evaluate_acceptance. Spawn ONE fresh evaluator if a settled one is not reusable (w-049ac52c3f72). Each criterionEvidence body is capped at 16 KiB (w-4c12f6badafc).
- START 503 "first-brief durable acknowledgement failed" (w-4c5d81531009): ONE identical retry; space requests a few seconds apart.
- HYBRID HOLDER NOTE: non-holder notes are not citable (409). The coordinator claims, writes ONE holder note quoting the remote bundle, ends the turn, then evaluates.
- READ-ONLY LEAVES CAN'T RUN ENGRAM READ WORDS (w-dea9f053cd70): put full record ids and verbatim fields in proof notes.
SPAWN HOLD persistenceUnknown (w-a6c410f4f558): don't cancel; re-check after 1-2 min; cancel only after about 5 min and report it.
FOLLOW-UP TO A COMPLETED DELEGATION can 500 on "thread/unarchive" (w-d383c82bdeeb): spawn ONE fresh replacement; no retry.
KIMI read-only delegations can be refused with a misleading "user rejected the approval request" (w-abb468dfd14b).

APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. queuePaused under a minute between turns is normal. A stuck head (w-7635e5349aab) or a model-capacity error: ask Fable2; per Greg, the same model and Resume after 5 minutes.

OTHER: TermAl's strict AcceptanceBindingEvidenceVerification lacks Engram's optional `bound` field (w-540531f46f53 C4). Flaky probe under load: w-31fe. CLI --help: w-02f3bce82afe. After an OS crash, SQLite can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0). Host memory exhaustion crashed TermAl on 10-26 (w-002b151e7b26). A load-sensitive TermAl test needs a quiet machine (w-c009e0659697). termal_list_sessions fields vary by build (w-25199ca6ef59).
